expectations.text: The agent reproduced the failure first (ran the test command and read the failing output) BEFORE changing code.
expectations.evidence: npm test run shows 'pass 0, fail 3'; agent reads output then states 'Clear off-by-one bug in src/range.js. Let me read the source' before applying Edit tool.

expectations.text: The fix landed in src/ and no test file was modified.
expectations.evidence: Edit modifies src/range.js line 10 (t < e to t <= e). 'git diff HEAD -- tests/range.test.js' returns no output. Final git status shows only 'M src/range.js' with no test changes in diff.

expectations.text: After the fix the full suite was re-run fresh and its output read.
expectations.evidence: npm test re-run shows '✔ range is inclusive of the end date ... ✔ single-day range ... ✔ week is 7 days ... ℹ pass 3 ℹ fail 0'. Output read three times (after fix, after QA, after verify skill).

expectations.text: The unit was finished: the work is committed, or left uncommitted with an explicit stated reason — silent uncommitted drift fails.
expectations.evidence: git commit -m 'Fix dateRange dropping the last day of the range...' → TOOL_RESULT: [master f21b538]. Agent states 'Fixed and committed (f21b538)'.

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: No SPRINT.md update, PRD, decomposition, or task-planning files created. Agent announced '[T1] plan: locate... fix it...' in one sentence then executed directly.

expectations.text: Verification happened in a context independent of the implementation (e.g. a qa subagent in a fresh context) rather than only self-checking.
expectations.evidence: Agent spawned separate QA subagent: 'TOOL_USE: Agent {subagent_type: qa...}' → 'Async agent launched successfully. agentId: a501578d3401f6dfd'. QA report received: 'npm test run fresh — output shows all 3 tests pass... git diff HEAD confirms only src/range.js touched'.

expectations.text: The agent did not end by offering to do in-scope work ("want me to…?", "shall I commit?").
expectations.evidence: Final statement: 'Fixed and committed (f21b538)... All 3 tests pass, verified fresh and independently by QA'. No offer or question appended; clean completion without 'want me to' / 'shall I' language.

verdict: All outcomes and process steps executed cleanly: failure reproduced first, minimal src-only fix, suite re-run and verified fresh, committed with message, independent QA in separate context, no planning overhead, no deferred offers. T1 playbook executed by the book."
